--- pipe_select_trailing_comma.sql
(FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x |> SELECT x,)
|> SELECT x,
|> WHERE TRUE

--- SQL
(FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x |> SELECT x) |> SELECT x |> WHERE TRUE
